_comment: DEPRECATED (2026-07, `specs/11`/`REVISION-PLAN.md`): the Claude Max subscription pilot is exiting the production ladder — retire this tiers file in Phase A, keeping a copy only if Lane A native fallback is repointed at LiteLLM aliases.
